common.action.accept: Button: accept an offer addressed to you (an event another community is handing over).
common.action.apply: Button: apply a pending choice (a cluster size on the seeding board).
common.action.cancel: A button that closes a dialog without saving.
common.action.change: Button on a correction line in an item dialog: open the line to change what it holds. The house verb; never Edit or Rename.
common.action.clear: Button: clear a field's value (a stage's start time).
common.action.close: Button: close a dialog once its work is done (after a re-pull has reported what it did). Beside it, before the work, the same place says Cancel.
common.action.decline: Button: turn down an offer addressed to you (an event another community is handing over).
common.action.delete: Button: delete the thing the dialog holds (a stage).
common.action.done: A button that closes a dialog after its work is finished.
common.action.keepEditing: Button beside Discard: keep the unsaved changes and stay in the editor.
common.action.manage: Button, or a verb in an accessible name: open something for managing (a stage, a moderator, a series).
common.action.remove: A button that removes the thing the dialog is about, after a confirmation.
common.action.save: A button that saves a form.
common.action.saveChanges: A form's one submit button (the Details forms on the event and tournament pages).
common.action.upload: Button that opens a file picker to upload an image into an empty slot.
common.action.view: Verb in an accessible name: open a stage for viewing (read-only).
common.apiKeys.created: Under an API key: when it was made. `` is where the date is drawn.
common.apiKeys.expired: On an API key's row: the key stopped working on this date. The tag is replaced by the date.
common.apiKeys.expires: On an API key's row: the date it stops working. The tag is replaced by the date.
common.apiKeys.intro: The paragraph above a person's API keys. The code span is a URL path and is not translated; the link opens the API documentation.
common.apiKeys.lastUsed: On an API key's row: the date of the last request made with it. The tag is replaced by the date.
common.apiKeys.lifetime.1y: A choice of how long a new API key lasts.
common.apiKeys.lifetime.30d: A choice of how long a new API key lasts.
common.apiKeys.lifetime.90d: A choice of how long a new API key lasts.
common.apiKeys.neverUsed: On an API key's row: no request has been made with it.
common.apiKeys.new.description: Accessible name of the box where a new API key's description is typed.
common.apiKeys.new.expiry: Accessible name of the dropdown that chooses how long a new API key lasts.
common.apiKeys.noExpiry: An API key that never stops working. Also the last choice in the list of lifetimes when making a key.
common.apiKeys.rateLimit: After the creation date of an API key that has its own request limit. `{n}` is the number of requests allowed each minute.
common.apiKeys.renew: Button on an API key's row: give the key another year before it expires.
common.apiKeys.revoke.confirm: Confirmation body for revoking an API key that has no description.
common.apiKeys.revoke.confirmNamed: Confirmation body for revoking an API key; {name} is the description the owner gave the key.
common.apiKeys.unnamed: Name shown for an API key made without a description.
common.avatar.animatedHint: Hint under the animated (Premium) avatar upload slot.
common.avatar.animatedLabel: Label of the Premium animated avatar upload slot.
common.avatar.animatedPerk: Subject of the Premium perk sentence shown when the animated avatar is locked: "An animated avatar is a Premium perk."
common.avatar.hint: Hint under the static avatar upload slot.
common.avatar.label: Label of the static avatar upload slot.
common.board.caution.plain: What a board says about its own order when nothing is taken off the rating.
common.board.caution.takenOff: What a board says about its own order; {n} is how many deviations are taken off the rating before ranking. The four amounts a community can pick are spelled out as words; any other number is written as digits.
common.brand.discord: Accessible name of the Discord logo. A brand name: usually left as it is.
common.characters.alsoPlays: Divider in a player's ordered character list, before the characters they play besides their declared team. Lowercase, drawn as a small label.
common.characters.empty: Shown in the character picker when the game has no characters.
common.characters.moveEarlier: Accessible name of the button moving a picked character one place earlier; {name} is the character, or "a retired character".
common.characters.moveLater: Accessible name of the button moving a picked character one place later; {name} is the character, or "a retired character".
common.characters.picked: Accessible name of a picked character tile; {n} is its position in the player's list (1, 2, 3…).
common.characters.readingRule.single: Under a character picker for a game where a player mains one character: what the order of the picks means. {subject} is "you" on a player's own settings and "they" on the staff dialog that edits somebody else's profile, which cannot say "your" about a player who is not the reader.
common.characters.readingRule.team: As common.characters.readingRule.single, for a game played as a team of {n} characters (Marvel vs. Capcom 3 is three).
common.characters.remove: Accessible name of the button removing a picked character; {name} is the character, or "a retired character".
common.characters.retired: Drawn in place of the name for a pick whose character has been retired from the roster.
common.characters.retiredName: Stands in for the character's name inside the move and remove buttons' names when the character is retired. Lowercase, mid-sentence.
common.claims.column.player: Column heading: the player each request wants to claim.
common.claims.ownRequest: In the actions column of the claims queue, on the viewer's own request, which they cannot approve or reject.
common.claims.via: Under the player a claim request names, when the player was matched by a Parry.gg account. `<link>` opens that account on Parry.gg.
common.composition.open: A bracket's entry shape where players and teams enter the same bracket. Also the last word of a bracket's default title.
common.composition.solo: A bracket's entry shape: one player per entrant. Also the last word of a bracket's default title (Lethal League Blaze Singles).
common.composition.team: A bracket's entry shape: teams of two per entrant. Also the last word of a bracket's default title (Lethal League Blaze Doubles).
common.consent.acceptAll: Cookie banner button accepting every optional cookie.
common.consent.notice: The cookie banner's one sentence. The two emphasised words name the two storage categories the buttons decide; the link opens the privacy notice. Dizzy is the product name and is not translated.
common.consent.prefs.analytics: Cookie category heading, and the name of its switch.
common.consent.prefs.analyticsHint: What the analytics cookies are for. Vercel Analytics and Umami are product names.
common.consent.prefs.appearance: Cookie category heading, and the screen-reader name of its switch. It covers the light or dark theme and the language.
common.consent.prefs.appearanceHint: What the appearance storage is for. Unlike the other switches it starts on, and turning it off stops the site remembering the theme and language between visits.
common.consent.prefs.description: Under common.consent.prefs.title. <link></link> links to the privacy notice.
common.consent.prefs.functionalHint: What the functional cookies are for.
common.consent.prefs.functionalLabel: Screen-reader name of the functional cookies switch.
common.consent.prefs.necessaryHint: What the strictly necessary cookies are for.
common.consent.prefs.necessaryLabel: Screen-reader name of the always-on switch.
common.consent.prefs.title: Title of the cookie preferences dialog.
common.control.dangerZone: Heading of the bordered section that holds a page's destructive actions (delete, reset).
common.control.games: Screen-reader name of the row of game tabs on a community or the home page.
common.control.loading: Screen-reader name of a spinning progress indicator.
common.control.moveDown: Button in a reorderable list; {item} names the row being moved.
common.control.moveUp: Button in a reorderable list; {item} names the row being moved.
common.count.brackets: A count with its noun, in one run of text; {n} is the count. A bracket is one tournament inside an event.
common.count.entrants: A count with its noun, in one run of text; {n} is the count.
common.count.events: A count with its noun, in one run of text; {n} is the count.
common.count.players: A count with its noun, in one run of text; {n} is the count.
common.count.pools: A count with its noun, in one run of text; {n} is the count. A pool is one group inside a stage.
common.count.rounds: A count with its noun, in one run of text; {n} is the count. A round of a Swiss stage.
common.count.sets: A count with its noun, in one run of text; {n} is the count. A set is one match between two entrants.
common.count.tournaments: A count with its noun, in one run of text; {n} is the count.
common.criteria.cancel: Screen-reader name of the button that drops a half-typed filter. {criterion} is the filter's short code (rating, main, country), shown to the reader in that form.
common.criteria.compare: Screen-reader name of the group of comparison buttons (≥, ≤, =) for a numeric filter.
common.criteria.filters: Heading over the list of filters a table's search box can apply.
common.criteria.onThisBoard: Heading over suggested filter values drawn from the rankings being searched.
common.criteria.remove: Screen-reader name of the button that removes an applied filter. {criterion} is its short code (rating, main); {value} is what it filters by.
common.criteria.searchFor: First row of a search box's suggestion list: search for exactly what was typed. <b> is drawn faded; {term} is the typed text.
common.criteria.value: Placeholder in the search box once a filter is chosen and its value is being typed.
common.criteria.valueLabel: Screen-reader name of the search box while a filter's value is typed. {criterion} is the filter's short code (rating, main).
common.crop.description: Description of the banner crop dialog.
common.crop.empty: Error in the image crop dialog when the cropped frame rendered nothing.
common.crop.loadFailed: Error in the banner crop dialog when the picked image cannot be decoded.
common.crop.renderFailed: Error in the banner crop dialog when the browser cannot draw the cropped image.
common.crop.title: Title of the dialog where a host frames an event banner before it uploads.
common.crop.zoom: Label and accessible name of the banner crop dialog's zoom slider.
common.date.ago.days: How long ago something happened, compact: days, up to six. Beyond a week the date itself is shown instead.
common.date.ago.minutes: How long ago something happened, compact: minutes. Shown in tight rows (a notification, a recent result). Keep it as short as the English.
common.date.away.days: How many days until an event starts, compact (in 5d). Lowercase because it sits inside a line of metadata.
common.date.away.live: How far away an event is, when it has already started. Lowercase because it sits inside a line of metadata.
common.date.from: Date-range picker label when only the start is set. {date} is a formatted date.
common.date.pickDateTime: Placeholder of a picker that sets both a date and a time.
common.date.time: Label of the time field under a calendar.
common.date.timeExample12: Placeholder showing the format of a time on a 12-hour clock. Write it the way a 12-hour time is written in your language.
common.date.until: Date-range picker label when only the end is set. {date} is a formatted date.
common.date.window.any: A sales or validity window with no start and no end.
common.date.window.between: A sales or validity window. {from} and {until} are formatted dates with times.
common.date.window.from: A window with a start and no end. {from} is a formatted date with a time.
common.date.window.until: A window with an end and no start. {until} is a formatted date with a time.
common.deleteDialog.typeToConfirm: Label over the box in a confirm dialog that stays locked until the word is typed. `<b>` wraps `{word}`, the word itself (for example DELETE), which is shown as typed and not translated.
common.delta.flat: A dashboard trend when a figure is the same as in the window before; drawn in place of a signed number such as "+12", followed by "on the window before".
common.distance: A distance as a reader sees it: {amount} is the number already written in the viewer's locale, {n} the value it stands for (for the unit's plural), {unit} is "km" or "mi".
common.distance.under: The distance floor for anything inside one unit; {unit} is "km" or "mi". Never a bare zero.
common.door.browseAll: Link from the community picker to the full directory.
common.door.communities: Group heading in the community picker when the viewer's town is unknown.
common.door.findLabel: Screen-reader name of the community picker's search box.
common.door.findPlaceholder: Placeholder in the community picker's search box.
common.door.near: Group heading in the community picker. {place} is the viewer's town.
common.door.noMatch: Shown when the community picker's search finds nothing.
common.door.online: Under a community's name: it plays online rather than in one place.
common.door.otherGame: Under a community that cannot be picked because it does not play the game being viewed.
common.door.pick: The navbar's community picker when no community is chosen.
common.door.switchLabel: Screen-reader name of the community picker when {community} is chosen.
common.door.worldwide: Group heading in the community picker.
common.door.yours: Group heading in the community picker: communities the viewer follows.
common.error.body: First paragraph of the error page.
common.error.eyebrow: Small label above an error page's heading.
common.error.global.body: Error page shown when the whole site frame failed to load, so no menus are drawn.
common.error.global.metaTitle: Browser tab title of that error page.
common.error.global.title: Heading of the error page shown when the whole site frame failed to load.
common.error.goHome: Link to the home page from an error page or the 404.
common.error.reference: Under an error page: the identifier support can look the failure up by. <code> wraps {digest}, drawn in a fixed-width font.
common.error.retry: Second paragraph of the error page; a reference code is shown below it.
common.error.title: Title of the page shown when a page fails to load.
common.eventMeta.entrantsIn: Follows an entrant count on an event card when there is no cap: "12 in" means twelve people have registered.
common.eventMeta.online: The place an online-only event card shows in place of an address.
common.eventStrength.notRated: Tooltip for a bracket with no strength figure; {pool} is the rating pool's name.
common.eventStrength.title: Tooltip on an event-strength figure; {value} and {max} are already-formatted numbers, {pool} is the rating board the reading is against, {n} is how many rated entrants it rests on.
common.feedback.bugPlaceholder: Placeholder in the description field for a bug.
common.feedback.descriptionLabel: Field label in the feedback form.
common.feedback.feature: Feedback type: something new is wanted.
common.feedback.featurePlaceholder: Placeholder in the description field for a feature request.
common.feedback.signIn: Shown in the feedback form to a signed-out viewer.
common.feedback.submitting: The submit button while feedback is sending.
common.feedback.title: Title of the feedback form, and its submit button.
common.feedback.titleLabel: Field label in the feedback form.
common.feedback.titlePlaceholder: Placeholder in the feedback title field.
common.feedback.type: Screen-reader name of the bug-or-feature choice.
common.follow.failed: Error under the Follow button when following or unfollowing fails without a reason.
common.follow.follow: Button to follow a community or game.
common.follow.followNamed: Accessible name of the Follow button; {label} names what is followed, a community or a game.
common.follow.following: The Follow button's label once the viewer follows the thing; pressing it unfollows.
common.follow.followingNamed: Accessible name of the Follow button once followed; {label} names the community or game.
common.footer.cookiePreferences: Footer link that reopens the cookie consent choices.
common.footer.helpTranslate: Footer link to the public translations repository, the door a volunteer is sent through. Dizzy is the product name and is not translated.
common.footer.privacy: Footer link to the privacy notice.
common.footer.whatsNew: Footer link to the release notes page.
common.form.setsWon: Under the home page's recent-form dots; {pct} is a whole-number percentage, emphasised as a figure.
common.home.band.boardOf: Beside the viewer's rank on a community board: the board's size and the share of the board they are in the top of.
common.home.band.curveEmpty: Where the rating curve goes, before the viewer has played two rated events.
common.home.band.curveSince: Under the rating curve. is replaced by the date of the first event on the curve.
common.home.band.days: A short span of days beside the rating change: 88d is 88 days.
common.home.band.form: Label over the viewer's win-loss record in their last few sets.
common.home.band.mains: Label over the viewer's rank among the players who play the same main character.
common.home.band.rating: Label over the viewer's rating figure.
common.home.band.steady: In place of a rating change when the rating has not moved.
common.home.band.trendTitle: Tooltip on the viewer's rating change.
common.home.band.unranked: Small label: the viewer's player has no rank on any board yet.
common.home.band.unrankedHint: Under common.home.band.unranked. {game} is a game's name.
common.home.calendar.empty: Small label: the viewer has entered no upcoming events.
common.home.calendar.emptyHint: Under common.home.calendar.empty. A seed is the viewer's starting position in the bracket.
common.home.claim.notLinked: Small label: the signed-in viewer has not linked a player.
common.home.claim.pending: Small label: the viewer asked to be linked to a player and is waiting.
common.home.claim.pendingReview: {player} is the player the viewer asked to be linked to; makes the name a link to them, dims the rest of the sentence.
common.home.climbs.subtitle: Subtitle under common.home.climbs.title.
common.home.climbs.title: Section heading on a signed-in player's home page: the board around them, the rivals just above and below.
common.home.door.emptyTitle: When the directory of communities is empty.
common.home.door.fromGame: Heading over a row of games, the second way in after picking a community.
common.home.door.title: Main heading of the home page for a visitor who follows no community.
common.home.eventsPlayed: Beside a number drawn separately just before it: how many of this community's events the viewer played in.
common.home.findEvents: Button to the game's list of tournaments, shown when the viewer has entered nothing.
common.home.findPlayer: Button taking the viewer to link their account to the player record they compete as.
common.home.follow: Button to follow a suggested community.
common.home.follower.eyebrow: Small label above the names of the communities a viewer follows, at the top of their home page.
common.home.follower.joined: How many communities the viewer has joined. wraps the number, drawn as a figure.
common.home.follower.linkPlayer: Under common.home.follower.noPlayer, explaining what linking a player adds to the home page.
common.home.follower.noPlayer: Small label: the signed-in viewer has not linked their account to a player record.
common.home.following: Tag: the viewer already follows this community.
common.home.horizon.band.later: Group heading over upcoming events further off than a month.
common.home.horizon.band.month: Group heading over upcoming events later in the next month.
common.home.horizon.band.week: Group heading over upcoming events in the next seven days.
common.home.horizon.empty: Shown when none of the viewer's communities has an upcoming event.
common.home.horizon.subtitle: Subtitle under common.home.horizon.title.
common.home.horizon.title: Section heading on the follower home page: upcoming events across the communities the viewer follows.
common.home.lastSets: Under the viewer's recent win-loss record: the record counts their last {n} sets (matches).
common.home.live: Tag on an event card: the event is happening now.
common.home.next.subtitle: Subtitle under common.home.next.title.
common.home.next.subtitleOpen: Subtitle under common.home.next.title when the viewer has entered nothing and is shown open events instead.
common.home.next.title: Section heading on the home page of a viewer who follows communities but has not linked a player: the events they have entered.
common.home.of: Beside a rank or a count, drawn larger just before it: 'out of' this many (#3 of 200; 5 of 32 entered).
common.home.openEvent: Under an event card: the event is open to anyone and belongs to no community.
common.home.suggestions.subtitle: Subtitle under common.home.suggestions.title.
common.home.suggestions.title: Section heading on a newly linked player's home page, suggesting communities to follow.
common.home.timeline.emptyHint: In the empty upcoming slot. A seed is the viewer's starting position in the bracket.
common.home.timeline.entered: After the entrant count (and common.home.of when the event has a cap): 12 of 32 entered.
common.home.timeline.entrants: The size of a past event's field, when the viewer has no placement in it.
common.home.timeline.eyebrow: Small label over a horizontal strip of the viewer's past and upcoming events.
common.home.timeline.field: Row label on an upcoming event card: how many have entered.
common.home.timeline.firstSets: Where the viewer's recent record goes before they have played a set.
common.home.timeline.lastSetsLabel: Screen-reader name for a row of small squares, one per recent set, won or lost.
common.home.timeline.lost: Screen-reader text before a set's score: the viewer lost the set.
common.home.timeline.lostAgainst: Screen-reader text for one recent-set square.
common.home.timeline.notSeeded: In place of a seed when the bracket has not been seeded.
common.home.timeline.nothingEntered: Over an empty slot on the timeline where upcoming events would be.
common.home.timeline.seed: Small label before the viewer's seed (starting position) in one bracket.
common.home.timeline.setsLabel: Screen-reader name for the list of sets the viewer played at one past event.
common.home.timeline.today: The marker for today on the timeline.
common.home.timeline.undated: In place of a date over a past event that has none.
common.home.timeline.where: Row label on an upcoming event card: the venue.
common.home.timeline.won: Screen-reader text before a set's score: the viewer won the set.
common.home.timeline.wonAgainst: Screen-reader text for one recent-set square.
common.home.tower.gap: Short column heading: the points between a player and the one ranked above.
common.home.tower.player: Column heading in the board around the viewer.
common.home.tower.points: Short column heading: the ranking points each player holds.
common.home.tower.standing: Under the board around the viewer: the community's name, the share of the board the viewer is in the top of, and the board's size.
common.home.tower.toYou: Short column heading: the points between a player and the viewer.
common.home.tower.wholeBoard: Link to the community's full board.
common.home.tower.you: In the viewer's own row, in place of a points gap to themselves.
common.home.via: Under an event card: the community running the event.
common.image.removeDescription: Body of the dialog confirming an image's removal.
common.image.removeTitle: Title of the dialog confirming an image's removal; {label} is the slot's label in lowercase, such as "avatar" or "banner".
common.image.sizeMb: A file size limit in megabytes, such as "2 MB".
common.image.tooLargeForSlot: Error under an image field when the picked file is over the slot's limit. {mb} is the file's size in megabytes, already formatted; {max} is the limit as a label such as "5 MB".
common.image.tooLargeForSlotUnsized: Error under an image field when the upload was refused for size and the file's size is not known. {max} is the limit as a label such as "5 MB".
common.image.typeNotAccepted: Upload error for a file type the slot refuses; {hint} is the slot's own hint sentence naming the types it takes.
common.image.uploadFailed: Error when an image upload fails without a reason.
common.location.add: The location control before the viewer has said where they are.
common.location.clearFailed: Error toast when the viewer's town cannot be forgotten.
common.location.forget: Button clearing the viewer's saved town.
common.location.heading: Heading of the location popover.
common.location.noMatch: Shown when a town search finds nothing.
common.location.promise: Beside the control where a viewer says which town they are in.
common.location.saveFailed: Error toast when the viewer's town cannot be saved.
common.location.searchLabel: Screen-reader name of the town search box.
common.markdown.image.alt.help: Under the alt-text box: what the description is for.
common.markdown.image.describe: Label for the alt text of an image being added to an event or bracket description.
common.markdown.image.tooLarge: Error when an image dropped into a description body is over the limit. {mb} is the file's size in megabytes, already formatted.
common.markdown.shelf.delete: Accessible name of an uploaded image's delete button. `{name}` is the file name.
common.markdown.shelf.heading: Heading over the row of images already uploaded for this event, which can be inserted again or deleted.
common.markdown.shelf.inUse: Badge on an uploaded image's tile when the description being edited uses it.
common.markdown.shelf.inUseLabel: Accessible name of an uploaded image's delete button while the description uses the image, so it is disabled. `{name}` is the file name.
common.markdown.shelf.insert: Accessible name of the button on an uploaded image's tile that inserts it. `{name}` is the file name.
common.meta.brand: The site's name, used as the application and site name in link previews. Keep as is.
common.meta.site.description: The site's default description in search results and link previews.
common.meta.site.title: The site's default page title and link-preview title.
common.meta.titleTemplate: How every page title is built: %s is replaced by the page's own title. Keep %s exactly.
common.nav.createEvent: Item in the account menu: opens the event wizard.
common.nav.dashboard: Menu item and label for the staff dashboard.
common.nav.menuTitle: Screen-reader title of the mobile menu panel.
common.nav.openMenu: Screen-reader name of the mobile menu button.
common.nav.profile: Item in the account menu: the viewer's account page.
common.nav.search: Screen-reader name of the navbar search button.
common.nav.searchTitle: Tooltip on the search button. {shortcut} is the keyboard shortcut, such as Ctrl K.
common.nav.section.rankings: Navbar link to a community's or game's ranked board of players.
common.nav.section.tournaments: Navbar link to the archive of tournaments.
common.nav.signIn: Navbar button to sign in; also the sign-in page's title.
common.nav.theme: Label beside the theme button in the mobile menu.
common.nav.toggleTheme: Screen-reader name of the navbar button that cycles light, dark and system themes.
common.notFound.body: Body of the 404 page. Dizzy is the site's name.
common.notFound.title: Title of the 404 page.
common.notSet: A field's value when nothing has been set (a stage's start time).
common.og.community.bare: Link-preview description's opening for a community that plays no games yet; it continues in common.og.community.description as {games}.
common.og.community.description: Link-preview description of a community page whose owner wrote none. {games} is common.og.community.games or common.og.community.bare. Dizzy is the site's name.
common.og.community.descriptionWithProve: As common.og.community.description, followed by {provenance}: a line saying which other communities' results the board also counts.
common.og.community.games: Link-preview phrase naming a community by what it plays. {games} is a comma-separated list of game titles.
common.og.event.inPerson: In an event's link-preview summary: the event happens at a physical venue.
common.og.event.online: In an event's link-preview summary: the event happens online.
common.og.events: A count of events in a link-preview summary line, between middle dots.
common.og.h2h.description: Link-preview description of the head-to-head page before two players are chosen. {game} is a game title.
common.og.h2h.score: Link-preview description of a head-to-head record: {a} and {b} are player names, {aWins} and {bWins} their set wins against each other, {game} the game title.
common.og.h2h.title: Link-preview title of the head-to-head page before two players are chosen. {game} is a game title.
common.og.h2h.versus: Link-preview title of a head-to-head between two players, {a} and {b}, in {game}.
common.og.player.main: In a player's link-preview summary: the character they mostly play. {character} is the character's name.
common.og.player.ranked: In a player's link-preview summary: their place on a board. {rank} is the place.
common.og.player.rankedIn: In a player's link-preview summary: their place on a community's board. {rank} is the place, {community} the community's name.
common.og.player.rating: In a player's link-preview summary: their rating number, {rating}.
common.og.player.unranked: In a player's link-preview summary, when no community's board ranks them.
common.og.players.description: Link-preview description of a game's player directory. {game} is a game title; Dizzy is the site's name.
common.og.players.title: Link-preview and tab title of a game's player directory. {game} is a game title.
common.og.section: Link-preview and tab title of one section of a community's pages: {community} is the community's name, {section} the section's own title (for example Tournaments, or Upcoming events).
common.og.series.kind: Opening of a series' link-preview summary. A series is a run of recurring tournaments; Dizzy is the site's name.
common.og.top8.description: Link-preview description of a tournament's top-eight page. {tournament} is the tournament's name, {game} the game title.
common.og.top8.title: Link-preview and tab title of a tournament's top-eight page. {tournament} is the tournament's name, {game} the game title.
common.og.tournament.description: Link-preview description of a tournament with no date. {n} is its number of entrants, {game} the game title.
common.og.tournament.descriptionDated: Link-preview description of a tournament. {n} is its number of entrants, {date} its date written year-month-day, {game} the game title.
common.og.tournaments: A count of tournaments in a link-preview summary line, between middle dots.
common.og.tournaments.description: Link-preview description of a game's tournament list. {game} is a game title; Dizzy is the site's name.
common.og.tournaments.title: Link-preview and tab title of a game's tournament list. {game} is a game title.
common.og.withGame: Link-preview and tab title of a page about one player or tournament, {subject}, in the game {game}.
common.optional: A placeholder in a field that may be left empty.
common.optionalHint: Beside a field label, in brackets: the field may be left empty.
common.pagination.firstLabel: Screen-reader name of the pager button that jumps straight to page 1. The button shows only an arrow.
common.pagination.goTo: Screen-reader name of a numbered page button. {page} is the page number.
common.pagination.jump: Screen-reader name of the current-page figure in a pager ("3 / 12"). Pressing it opens a box to type a page number into.
common.pagination.jumpInput: Screen-reader name of the box where a page number is typed, then Enter goes there. {pages} is the last page.
common.pagination.lastLabel: Screen-reader name of the pager button that jumps straight to the final page. The button shows only an arrow.
common.pagination.more: Screen-reader text for the ellipsis between page numbers.
common.pagination.next: Pager button, visible beside an arrow on wider screens.
common.pagination.pageOf: Phone pager: which page of how many. Each <b> wraps a figure.
common.pagination.previous: Pager button, visible beside an arrow on wider screens.
common.pagination.showing: Above a paged list. Each <b> wraps figures; {items} is a plural noun for what is listed (players, tournaments), supplied in English by the page for now.
common.person.search: Placeholder of a box that finds a user account.
common.placement.champion: First place, named rather than numbered.
common.placement.equal: Over a group of finishers who share a placement; {place} is an ordinal (5th).
common.placement.runnerUp: Second place, named rather than numbered.
common.placement.unplaced: A finisher with no placement recorded.
common.premiumPerk.note: Marks a control only Premium subscribers can use. The empty is where the feature goes ("An animated avatar", "Changing your handle"); goes to the Premium section of the profile.
common.privacyNotice: Link to the privacy notice, placed after a sentence that says some data becomes public.
common.provisional.appearance: One appearance of a provisional player: the name they registered under, then the event. `<b>` wraps the event's name.
common.provisional.appearance.date: After common.provisional.appearance, when the tournament has a date. `` is where the date is drawn.
common.provisional.confirmAll.title: Dialog title confirming every provisional entry at once as a new player; {n} is how many.
common.provisional.confirmGroup.descript: Dialog body when a group of provisional entries sharing one name is confirmed as one player; {name} is that name.
common.provisional.confirmGroup.title: Dialog title confirming a group of provisional entries as one player; {n} is how many entries.
common.provisional.group.shared: Under a name that several provisional players share. `{n}` is always 2 or more.
common.provisional.merge.consequence: The consequence line in the merge dialog: {n} entries named {name} are removed and their records move to the chosen player {to}, which is emphasised.
common.provisional.split: Button: treat the players grouped under one name as separate people again.
common.ratingFigure.deviation: Tooltip on the ± figure beside a rating: how uncertain the rating still is.
common.ratingFigure.someDoubt: The caution clause in a rating figure's tooltip when the board's exact setting is not known.
common.ratingFigure.title: Tooltip on a rating figure; {caution} is the board's caution sentence (common.board.caution.*) or common.ratingFigure.someDoubt when the board's setting is unknown.
common.realtime.connecting: Live connection indicator in the stream control room: the page is still connecting to live updates. Ends with an ellipsis.
common.realtime.live: Live connection indicator in the stream control room: live updates are arriving.
common.realtime.offline: Live connection indicator in the stream control room: live updates are not arriving, so the page falls back to slower refreshes.
common.search.ctrlK: The keyboard shortcut that opens search, as printed on a non-Mac keyboard. Use the local name of the Control key.
common.search.description: Screen-reader description of the site search box.
common.search.event: Under a search result: the row is an event.
common.search.eventTournaments: Under a search result: the row is an event holding {n} tournaments (always more than one).
common.search.failed: Shown when the search request fails.
common.search.noMatch: Shown when a search finds nothing.
common.search.placeholder: Placeholder in the site search box.
common.search.results: Screen-reader status: how many search results are shown.
common.search.searching: Screen-reader status while search results load.
common.search.series: Group heading in search results: tournament series.
common.search.short: Short placeholder of a table's search box.
common.search.title: Title of the site search box. Dizzy is the site's name.
common.search.yourCommunities: Group heading in search, before anything is typed.
common.search.yourGames: Group heading in search, before anything is typed: the games the viewer plays.
common.settings.group.broadcast: Heading of a group in the Settings tree on a tournament page: the settings for streaming it (the streams, the queue).
common.settings.group.commerce: Heading of a group in the Settings tree: where money lives (payments and discount codes on an event, the prize pool on a tournament).
common.settings.group.competition: Heading of a group in the Settings tree on a tournament page: how the bracket is run (its stages, how sets are run).
common.settings.group.moderation: Heading of the last group in the Settings tree: what only staff may touch (the destructive Advanced node, the changelog).
common.settings.group.overview: Heading of the first group in the Settings tree: what the event or tournament is (its details, setup health, links).
common.settings.group.people: Heading of a group in the Settings tree: who runs the event or tournament (roles and staff).
common.settings.health.openSeeding: Link on a setup health item saying a bracket is not seeded: opens its seeding.
common.settings.health.publish: Link on a setup health item saying a bracket is still a draft: goes to where it is published. "it" is the bracket.
common.settings.health.routeStream: Link on a setup health item saying no stream is sending a tournament's sets: opens its Streams settings.
common.settings.node.advanced: A node in the Settings tree on both the event and tournament pages, and its panel's title: the destructive actions (re-pull, correct the game, delete).
common.settings.node.details: A node in the Settings tree on both the event and tournament pages, and its panel's title: the name, date and description.
common.settings.node.health: A node in the Settings tree on both pages, and its panel's title: a checklist of what still needs doing before the event or bracket can run.
common.settings.node.links: A node in the Settings tree on both pages, and its panel's title: the public URL, the external bracket link and the videos.
common.settings.node.roles: A node in the Settings tree on both pages, and its panel's title: who hosts and staffs the event or tournament.
common.settings.title: The gear row in the side rail of an event or tournament page that opens the Settings tree.
common.setupHealth.clear: Shown in place of a setup checklist when nothing needs attention.
common.signIn.discord: Sign-in button. Discord is the only sign-in method.
common.signIn.title: Heading of the sign-in page.
common.skipToContent: Keyboard link, the first stop on every page, jumping past the header.
common.sparkline.label: Accessible name of the rating curve on the home page. {n} is how many events it spans; {from} and {to} are the first and last rating figures.
common.status.failed: Generic error under a control when an action fails without a reason.
common.status.saveFailed: Status word after a save that did not go through.
common.status.saved: Status word after a successful save.
common.status.saving: Status word while a save is in flight; ends with an ellipsis.
common.streamQueue.ahead: A set's place in a stream's queue, where the channel is already named nearby; {ahead} is how many sets play on that stream first (always two or more).
common.streamQueue.aheadIn: A set's place in a stream's queue; {ahead} is how many sets play on that stream first (always two or more) and {handle} is the channel's name, shown after @.
common.streamQueue.beforeYours: Spoken to a player about their own set's place in a stream's queue, where the channel is already named nearby; {ahead} is how many sets play first (always two or more).
common.streamQueue.beforeYoursOn: Spoken to a player about their own set's place in a stream's queue; {ahead} is how many sets play first (always two or more) and {handle} is the channel's name, shown after @.
common.streamQueue.onStream: A set is being broadcast right now, where the channel is already named nearby.
common.streamQueue.onStreamOn: A set is being broadcast right now; {handle} is the channel's name, shown after @.
common.streamQueue.upNext: A set is the next one to be broadcast, where the channel is already named nearby.
common.streamQueue.upNextOn: A set is the next one to be broadcast; {handle} is the channel's name, shown after @.
common.unit.entrants: The unit word beside a separately drawn figure; {n} is the figure and only picks the plural.
common.unit.games: The unit word beside a separately drawn figure; {n} is the figure and only picks the plural.
common.unit.players: The unit word beside a figure that is drawn separately (a stat tile, a styled number); {n} is the figure and only picks the plural.
common.unit.series: The unit word beside a separately drawn figure; {n} is the figure and only picks the plural. A series is a run of recurring tournaments.
common.unit.titles: The unit word beside a series holder's title count, which is drawn as a figure before it; {n} only picks the plural.
common.unit.tournaments: The unit word beside a separately drawn figure; {n} is the figure and only picks the plural.
common.unit.wins: The unit word under a head-to-head side's win count, which is drawn above it; {n} only picks the plural.
common.vs: Between two players in a pairing row: versus, abbreviated.
common.whatsNew.group.added: Heading over the notes in one release that announce something new. The release notes themselves stay in English.
common.whatsNew.latest: A small badge beside the newest release's date on the What's new page.
